## Quarto

```{r}
library(gt)
# Create a list of data pairs
data <- list("Housing" = 238, "Food" = 154, "Transportation" = 453, "Internet" = 121, "Entertainment" = 228)

data <- as.data.frame(data)

data2 <- data.frame(category = 
                  c("Housing", "Food", "Transportation", "Internet", "Entertainment"), 
           cost = c(238, 154, 453, 121, 228))

data2$category <- as.factor(data2$category)
           
gt(data2)

# Define colors for the bars
colors <- c("yellow", "yellow", "lightgreen", "yellow", "yellow")  # Set the color of the third bar to light green

# Create a bar chart
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data2, aes(x = category, y = cost)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = colors) +
  labs(title = "Revenue by Category", x = "Category", y = "Revenue ($)") 

```
